svg.title: Throughput by workload
svg.desc: and: sift 8,525, sift (positions off) 9,004, pg_search 1,788, pg_textsearch 65, rum 1,906, pgx-bm25 74, Elasticsearch 6,425; or: sift 2,825, sift (positions off) 3,021, pg_search 1,306, pg_textsearch 2,900, rum 18, pgx-bm25 59, Elasticsearch 4,042; phrase: sift 7,485, sift (positions off) 2,062, pg_search 1,623, pg_textsearch 77, rum 68, pgx-bm25 43, Elasticsearch 9,829; mixed: sift 5,073, sift (positions off) 3,162, pg_search 1,516, pg_textsearch 89, rum 37, pgx-bm25 44, Elasticsearch 7,176; count(*): sift 9,610, sift (positions off) 2,557, pg_search 1,665, pg_textsearch 79, rum 75, pgx-bm25 41, Elasticsearch 12,807; filter: sift 4,093, sift (positions off) 3,718, pg_search 1,355, pg_textsearch 73, rum 34, pgx-bm25 44, Elasticsearch 6,251; join: sift 2,106, sift (positions off) 1,398, pg_search 276, pg_textsearch 78, rum 34, pgx-bm25 46, Elasticsearch 6,875
svg.text: queries per second, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 3-7); Oct 2026.
